items.q: How long does company formation take?
items.a: Timelines vary by activity and regulatory requirements. From the first consultation, we share a clear expected schedule and keep you updated at every stage.

items.q: Can I form a company with 100% foreign ownership?
items.a: Yes. We help foreign investors establish 100% foreign-owned companies in permitted activities, including licensing and registration with the relevant authorities.
Required documents depend on the entity type and activity. After understanding your project, we provide a clear, up-to-date checklist so your file is prepared quickly and accurately.
Yes. We support you after formation with operations readiness, banking, residencies when needed, and ongoing administrative and operational support.

items.q: Can I request more than one service?
items.a: Absolutely. Multiple services can be combined into one path — such as formation, legal, financial, and digital transformation — based on your project stage.

items.q: How do I start a consultation?
items.a: Start through the consultation page or the “Book consultation” button. Our team will contact you to understand your needs and map the right path to begin.
